decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (025-PE-XX-00-DR-A-014 Rev P01, 025-PE-XX-01-DR-A-013 Rev P01, 025-PE-XX-00-DR-A-012 Rev P01, 025-PE-XX-00-DR-A-008 Rev P01, 025-PE-XX-XX-DR-A-005 Rev P01, 025-PE-XX-00-DR-A-004 Rev P01, 025-PE-XX-XX-DR-A-003 Rev P01, 025-PE-XX-00-DR-A-002 Rev P01 (received 23/10/2013)
025-PE-XX-ZZ-DR-A-0801 Rev C01, 025-PE-XX-XX-DR-A-001 Rev E (received 07/10/2013)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the materials approved in the application.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the erection of the canopy, full details of the proposed canopy shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The erection of the canopy shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - Prior to any equipment, machinery or materials being brought onto the site for the purposes of the development a tree protection plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.   The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in the protected area and the ground levels shall not be altered, not shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 6 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of 5 years? from the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use.

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 7 - The building shall not be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  These works shall then be carried out within three months of the occupation of the development.  These details shall include means of enclosure; hard surfacing material and minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc). Soft landscape works shall include planting plans;  schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate and an implementation programme.
Condition : 8 - The measures contained in the Travel Plan shall be implemented as approved.
Condition : 9 - The cycle storage shall be implemented as approved prior to the occupation of the extensions.

Condition : 10 - The electric car charging point shall be provided as specified in the application prior to the occupation of the buildings.  The electric car charging point shall then be maintained in working order for as long as the development remains in existence.
Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out and used in accordance with the Delivery and Servicing Plan and Construction Logistics Plan submitted with the application.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and a single storey side extension to enable the school to increase its capacity to four forms of entry.
